about: The words of woodcore-cli's `sync` command and of what `check` says about sync.json, in the three languages (calc/cli_sync.py, v0.117, issue #33): the window writes its own, in calc/tools/structure_tab.py, which a terminal cannot import. The other commands of woodcore-cli speak English, like every message of the pipeline; this one was asked in three. A refusal's own sentence is the domain's, in English (sync.SyncError, sharing.SharingError) -- only its frame is translated, its code naming it in every language. tests/test_cli_sync.py holds the three languages to the same keys and every key used to one of them.

fr.not_moved: {node} est déjà à cette place : rien n'a été écrit

fr.check_in_step: les documents partagés sont à jour
fr.unfold_nothing: Aucune vérification dépliée dans ce projet.
fr.unfold_no_match: la forme ne correspond plus aux données — régénérer
